notes: Primary origin https://www.motorola.com/ redirects to /us/en/homepage (slug index); the other 9 captured pages are /at/de/. Home-only fields read the US index per spec; AT homepage equivalents are recorded alongside where they differ.
#cf4039 (62 weight, button-background on 9 pages) is the third-party Confirmit digital-feedback tab #cffbtb "Rückmeldung" (Open Sans, 0px radius) — excluded from palette roles; not brand.

Header is WHITE (#ffffff, fixed, 88px = 19px announcement bar #e9eaf2 + 69px nav row) on BOTH the US index and AT pages at 1440 and 360 (census surfaces[header]). The brief's "US black header" is not supported by the census; the dark band in index-thumb.png is the newsletter-modal overlay.

Home-only vs cross-page radius: home pages are dominated by 100px pill CTAs (at-de-homepage radii: 100px×20, 16px×2); cross-page mode by area and count is 16px (image tiles/cards). Primary=16px, buttons=100px.

Palette capped at 8. Dropped: #ffffff4d (white 30% footer borders — leftover from the dark-footer base theme, invisible on white), #514f51 (inactive tab text / swatch dots), #3b3b3b, #757575 (swiper pagination), #3a384d/#3d4161/#7e8f84/#007c6d/#315592/#56644e/#a0b9c6/#e2e2da/#5a4575/#b44580/#d1dee9/#00b5d7 (product colour-swatch dots, offers/contest), #00529c (newsletter consent link), #00264d (newsletter input border).
Logo PNG brand mark colour is #685bc6 (sampled from assets/logo.png); this purple appears nowhere in computed CSS colour.

CSS custom properties: 2179 utility "atom" tokens (--atom-color-*, --atom-padding-*, …) + legacy Lenovo palette vars (--lenovo-red #E1251B, --dark-blue #11184F …). No semantic --primary/--secondary. Molecule classes (typo-*, btn-*) are the de-facto design system.
cssBackgrounds: url("…/at/de/undefined") repeats on 4 AT pages — a broken CMS background binding, not a motif.
at-de-razr-fold-fifa-world-cup-edition contains a looping muted <video> (src null at capture) — page-level, not home; heroMedium stays null.
Spacing scale not measured by the census (only button paddings, header/footer metrics) — left empty rather than inferred.

type.weightRendering: Montserrat @font-face rules declare single weights 400/500/700 pointing at a variable (wght 100–900) file. Computed font-weight 600 (all h1/h2) matches the 700 face and is clamped to 700 by the descriptor, so 600 headings RENDER at 700. Replicate by keeping the three single-weight rules, not by declaring a 100 900 range.

scaleAudit.basis: per-level weighted-score sizes at 1440 sorted desc: h2 48 → h1 40 → h4 36 → h3 22. Levels are also non-monotonic (h4 > h3). The authored molecule ramp (100/56/48/40/32/28/24/18/16/14/12) is likewise non-modular.

type.loadStrategy: Montserrat rules carry no font-display (browser default = auto/block); Gotham/MotoSans swap; icomoon block
